falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match score versus bottom_2022_may_luna falls below 50% and the primary risk asset closes more than 10% below its lowest daily close of the prior 20 sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The Luna-bottom analog has failed and the tape is a continuing breakdown, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is wrong and the regime is identifiable risk-off

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score rises from 38 to 65 or higher, or the S&P 500 closes at a 20-day high on a day VIX closes below 14
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The regime is identifiable euphoric risk-on rather than an uncertain bottom, so UNKNOWN/HOLD missed a directional long/blowoff state

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match to bottom_2022_may_luna reaches 90% or higher and the primary risk asset rallies at least 10% off its low of the next 14 days, with reversal-day spot volume at least 1.5x its 20-day average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The May 2022 Luna-style capitulation bottom has confirmed, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was wrong and the correct call was a tactical long

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
